name: CONSOLEV
summary: Quiet-premium strategy consultancy site: light-weight tight grotesk with italic serif accents, warm stone canvas, inset dark, cream and forest panels, numbered editorial labels.

fonts.pairing: Inter Display 300 with -0.045em tracking for big headings, Instrument Serif italic for one emphasised word per heading and all quotes, Inter body and wide-tracked 11px caps labels

signature: thin 300-weight grotesk headlines ending in one italic serif word
numbered caps labels like (01) WHY on every section
glass progress-bar card floating on the hero photo
circular cut-out portrait with a pill caption for the founder
forest-green panel with misty pine photo behind frosted quote cards
imagery: warm documentary office photography, candid teams, a calm founder portrait, misty forest and coastline landscapes
layout_grid: 1136px content, 32px side padding, 150px section padding, 12px gutter for inset panels, 4-column principle cards and 2-column framework grid
